headline: Israel Prepares Gulf Escalation as Ukraine Strikes Deep Inside Russia
subheadline: IDF strikes Hamas infrastructure after IED attack while Ukrainian drones hit Bashneft refinery and Tsymbulovo drone base in Oryol region.
lede: Israel prepares for widespread escalation in the Persian Gulf while Ukrainian forces struck deep inside Russia, hitting the Bashneft oil refinery in Bashkortostan and the Tsymbulovo drone launch base in Oryol region. The IDF confirmed strikes on Hamas infrastructure in Gaza following an IED attack on an engineering vehicle with no casualties reported. Saudi airstrikes in Yemen killed six civilians including two children and a woman, while Iraq pledged to disarm Iran-backed militias by June 2027.

sections.title: Ukraine Strikes Russian Oil Refinery and Drone Bases
sections.body: Ukrainian drones attacked the Bashneft oil refinery in Bashkortostan, one of Russia's largest refining centers, and destroyed the Kasta-2E2 radar system in Donetsk region valued at $60 million. Forces also hit the main Tsymbulovo reactive drone base in Oryol region, damaging bunkers, warehouses, and Geran-5 launch pads. Russia responded with ballistic missiles on Kamianetske, Pavlohrad, and Zaporizhzhia, plus two Zircon hypersonic missiles on Kremenchuk and widespread Shahed deployments across northern and central Ukraine.

sections.title: Gulf Escalation Fears as IDF Strikes Hamas Infrastructure
sections.body: The IDF struck Hamas infrastructure in Gaza after an IED attack on an engineering vehicle, calling it a blatant ceasefire violation with no casualties reported. A senior Israeli official revealed preparations for widespread escalation in the Persian Gulf with potential Israeli involvement. Saudi airstrikes on Al-Mokha and Taiz killed six civilians including two children and a woman, injuring eight, while Iraq committed to disarming Iran-backed militias by June 2027 with factions handing over strategic weapons from March.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous escalation in Gaza, Lebanon, Yemen, and the Persian Gulf indicates a broadening regional conflict with Israel's Gulf preparations suggesting anticipation of multi-front war. Iran's hardened UAV infrastructure in Lorestan and cross-border drone activity signal enhanced offensive readiness, while Ukraine's deep strikes demonstrate significant long-range capability against strategic Russian targets. Iraq's militia disarmament pledge could degrade Iran's proxy network but faces significant implementation risks.
